scenarios.name: enters-and-destroys-an-opponent-creature
scenarios.why: When Ravenous Chupacabra enters it destroys target creature an opponent controls: the aimed-at Bear leaves the battlefield and the Chupacabra stays.

scenarios.name: own-creatures-are-not-legal-targets
scenarios.why: The trigger targets only creatures an OPPONENT controls: when p1 has no creature the trigger has no legal target and is removed from the stack without asking (CR 115.5), so p0's own Bear survives.
